text: Go to coffee spot in passyunk square! We love this spot and always recommend it to people looking for coffee in the area. Highly recommend!!
Very safe place!  The waitstaff even asked about food allergies!  I've never had any server ask that!  So impressive!  Sarah was a great waitress and the food was amazing!

Went for dinner this past week. Great service and food. Loved the empanadas colombianas and got the tallarín saltado con pollo. The sauce on the tallarín saltado was very flavorful and I thought the chicken went paired well with the special sauce. My girlfriend ordered the pollo a la brasa - which she pointed out that it was roasted perfectly after her first bite. I ended up eating the leftovers for lunch the next day and thought, even reheated, it was spectacular. Also loved the paintings up on the walls in Cocina Latina. Looking forward to my next visit!

Great comfort food, cool vibe.  There was only 2 other occupied tables when we went on a Saturday night... took us an hour to get our food and my sister ordered another beer (twice) and he never brought a beer.  Fine, people forget, no big deal.. then he brought the check 45 min later with the other beer on it, rolled his eyes when my sister kindly told him she never received it and corrected the bill without apologizing. 

The place could be really great, if the service was at minimum kind.  We were really hopeful going in, disappointed leaving.
The best vegan soul food I've ever taste hands down. You will not be disappointed and you will make sure you will come back for another delicious home cooked meal

This place is a great find when it comes to authentic Indian food in Philly. I tried coming here on a Sunday and it was packed with people waiting in line on the inside, so I decided to come back on a weekday evening with a friend when we didn't have to wait to be seated. The place was still relatively busy with only 1 or 2 vacant tables. The first thing I noticed is that service time is rather slow. It takes a while for the server to take our orders, and definitely over 30 minutes between placing the order and food to arrived. I had the chicken biryani which seemed small in the pot it came in, but boy was the actual portion huge. I loved the flavors in the biryani and the well cooked basmati rice. My only regret was not being able to finish everything on my plate. I also had the mango lassi to start, which was well done.

Ordered delivery through DoorDash - the wait wasn't too bad and the food was delicious!
I ordered the cheeseburger rolls, as well as a slice of the pineapple upside down cake which was amazing! Also ordered the factory lemonade, very tart but decent amount (no ice) for $2.50. Also came with their breads and butter!

First time at Jane's and I regret not having been sooner! Their pizzas are delicious (my favorite so far is the margherita) and service is phenomenal! Outdoor seating at night creates a beautiful date night feel. The portion sizes and quality of the meals are worth the slightly high menu prices. The cocktails are worth it too!

My very classy family and I came here to get intoxicated and crush seafood before the beach on Sunday funday.  I'm used to way higher priced drinks, so I was pretty much mind blown drinking $6 Bloody Mary's with shrimps and olives garnishes.  We all loved the oysters, mussels, and blackened grouper.

This is the third time I've come here and they have either gotten my order wrong or given me half the portion they used to. The portion sizes

Down to one star for another wrong order.....receipt says chicken lo mein  we got shrimp fried rice. Brother is very allergic to shrimp to top it off.

We loved this place. While we were visiting the STL for a weekend vacation we looked up Mexican food places and this place popped up. Very authentic food, atmosphere is great with several TV's playing in the background. We had great service and encountered friendly patrons.

Service pretty rude except to locals, food was not as flavorful as i expected. Shrimp n grits didnt have any kind of gravy/sauce- just grease. Shrimp were tasty tho, grits were creamy but fairly bland- a sauce really could make it a winner. Also got the Mardi Gras Mambo- the fish was the best part. Well seasoned, crispy. But the mac and cheese was tasteless, even the crawfish cream sauce suffered from lack of flavor. Did i catch em on a bad day? I had high hopes but definitely wont go back n wouldnt recommend.

This spot was great, we got the catfish and Quarter dark chicken with greens and macaroni it was good. The Kool-Aid -aid was sweet. The Carmel cake was good too! The staff was super friendly and we got to meet the owner she was a nice lady!

This is a review from my visit a year ago. When My husband and I went in with two friends a group of people came to our table, which I thought was awkward, chatted for a moment, and left. Well AFTER we had paid out bill, the Flowing Tide added their entire  bill and charged our card.  As in over 100$.

Had to go down to get the money which had been blatantly taken without authorization.  Told them very plainly that they needed to contact the police and press charges on those people that didn't pay. They ended up giving me the funds back, only because I had the original receipt that I was prepared to dispute with my bank.  

My advice is to keep your receipt as this business will adds funds to your card after you have paid your tab and left. 

Also,  Apparently there is an automatic gratuity added to the check if you go with another person.  18 percent which is automatically added in, an out in very small print.  Right above the tip line.

Great view, way overpriced.  Has a food truck feel for prices that should be in an upscale restaurant.  This trend is becoming more and more common, but I don't have to like it.  When my wife and I visited, we just kept walking a little further to Columbia and got some decent priced food.

This would have to be consistently the worst place I stop for a cheap dinner or lunch! My greet took all of 10 minutes and she had walked by us several times in the bar open tables. When she did greet us it was to say I'll be with you in one moment, well after sitting for 10 minutes we decided to move to the bar itself. That was a mistake, the bartender asked us our drinks and we told her two of the drinks of the month, and I'd like a summer strawberry thing they got their drinks after 4 minutes and I got mine 8 minutes after that, oh and we had told her our order when she asked us for drinks so we could knock it all out at once..... 42 minutes later our food arrived ... I asked several times for a buffalo sauce and when I was finished with my fries I decided to get it myself. The riblets were disgusting shrimp and tenders were great but this was my last time trying to have a decent experience at Thompson lanes Applebee's !!!!

Very good.  1st time I went there was an hour wait.  Next time I went I set up a reservation but when I got there plenty of seating was available both time were Friday at 7 in back to back week.  The conveyor belt of food is nice when your sitting next to it.  It's not bad when you have to get up to get it but better having a seat next to it.  I'd recommend the combo with Korean BBQ.  It's a fun experience cooking your own food and it's always hot since it's cooked at your table.  I'd highly recommend it for dates or group outings.  Also they have Stella so that's a plus.

We were there  at Sunday lunch time . They has lunch menu and brunch menu. We  picked the pre fixed menu from Tampa Bay Restaurant Week . My salad was  delicious -with good dressing and fresh veggie. I had  shrimps and crab  linguine. The chunk of  fresh crab meat and big shrimp  with the delicious sauce made this  linguine taste so good. I thought  it was better than the linguine from Italian restaurant . The desert I chose poppy seed pound cake. The presentation was beautiful with the chopped strawberry , cream and mint. But the cake was dry and hard. I left it unfinish. The service and ambience were excellent. For fresh seafood restaurant, this is one of the good choices.

Rise 'n Roll Bakery is currently one of my favorite weekend treats! Their donuts & pastries are amazing. Not to mention they have multiple options for coffee! The staff is very friendly. I would recommend doing your research before going because the line is always decently long & you will definitely feel the pressure of being undecided once you hit the counter to order. This would be my only negative about the bakery, but as the owner, it's a good thing to always be busy. Another tip, make sure you check their hours of operation. I am always craving donuts on a Sunday, so it's helpful to remember they are not open on Sundays. The donuts are usually good a day or two afterwards, too. Rise 'n Roll Bakery is also very active on social media! I recently won a giveaway at their Fishers location. I would highly recommend stopping in. Whether you are local or an out of town guest, you won't be disappointed with Rise 'n Roll! Did I also mention they cater?! I have worked a few weddings & events where they have supplied the donuts. GAME CHANGER!

This is a great neighborhood restaurant and they deliver!  The food comes piping hot!  We love eating inside also, but with In the Covid 19 era, we are thrilled they deliver! Supporting your local restaurants is just as important once they reopen, as we want this restaurant to survive and prosper.  Thank you Anthony's!

Stopped here for lunch on a. Saturday around 1130 while getting a car serviced.  Really interesting architecturally inside, lots of wood low volume Spanish music.  Nice surprise in Pasco. All staff masked up and took our temperature at the door.  Told new menu and new management. 

Im not very familiar with Puerto  Rician  food although the menu, accessed via QR code smart phone camera, is both inEnglish and Spanish.   Bryan, our waiter, was fantastic in explaining the menu items prep and ingredients.   

Food: beef empanada to start. Was good but not sure how you could mess it up.  Lunch we had the Pionono and the Memposteado rice and steak. Both had wonderfully new flavors for me; unfortunately the steak was very very tough.  The steak was the only sub par element of the entire lunch but enough to knock a five star meal to at 4 or 3.5. The Pionono was amazing, a sweetish mashed plantain cup filled with beef Piccadillo and topped with cheese and a medium fried egg exactly as ordered.  White rice and red beans in a cup rounded it out.  The memposteado rice  was a mix of red beans bacon, ham really flavorful. Lunch capped by a vanilla flan, was thicker than most flan and I missed the caramelization of more traditional Mexican flan but this was an excellent variant.   Looking forward to dinner in the near future.
The empress lo-mein is the best lo-mein I've ever had in my entire life! Every time I'm in New Orleans I HAVE TO GET IT!

Best gyro in Saint Louis....and I don't say that lightly! I get the supreme with black olives and feta, and gyro fries with added tzatziki sauce. Soooo good

food is always ready on time, orders are always fulfilled correctly even with pickier customizations.
Food was good. Prompt delivery to my hotel without calling me "lost". Had $5.99 each deal.  Worth it. Convenient when arriving late from travels.
Nope, never again. Terrible service and VERY mediocre Philly Steak. Not worth the headache. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

Had lunch here with 3 others. The food was very tasty. The service was an abomination. They had the 12 years old son serving. There was only two tables with guests. We waited 25 minutes for our drinks. That was after I got up and asked for them. The food came out in spurts... remember, there was only 4 of us! As much as we enjoyed the food, I doubt I would ever go back.

I have eaten at Ponzio's for decades and never had an experience that would merit a bad rating. They are definitely one of the better diners in the area. The bread basket is delicious.  The service varies from excellent to okay, but the food is good. I love the snapper soup and the barramundi. They will cook/serve it with less butter if you ask, which I appreciate.  Fortunately, the meals are very filling, so any desire for one of the desserts in the display in the waiting area is minimized.  If you order a salad with pears, they are canned but that is to be expected at a diner, along with the side salad being mostly comprised of iceberg lettuce, but my preferences for real fruit and spring mix are not necessarily the norm.

Ordered online..  lady calls me and says I am too far to deliver so I have to add another entree.  This is a trick they use. My bill was 30$.  Had it been 20$ they still would have called.  The minimum states 15$. There is a delivery fee. Also a delivery zone. They say 5 miles is too far but they'll do it if you pay.   This time I questioned it and said cancel my order and she immediately said " no no you loyal customer I want to make you happy " well if she was sincere than I appreciate it but behind it my food was absolute shit. It was thrown out.  Everything cold and soupy.  The generals chicken wasn't in the right sauce. The bourbon chicken had a weird taste and smell of like mint(cleaning chemical) the crab ragoons were absolutely atrocious.  Soggy. Cramped in a bag.   I don't know what the deal is with this place but I'm done with them.     If you want to deliver. Deliver. If you want to gauge us for extra $$ to do your job than go be a doctor or a la
We loved this place! Super cute, yummy food and the waiter helped us with all our questions and was very attentive. A very good experience and I would recommend to anyone!

Do you like delicious asian food, good service and professional staff? Then you'll hate Asuka! This place was bad before they remodeled it and now its just as bad! Maybe worse. Do yourself a favor and keep going down Oddie till you get to The Wok and enjoy some good food.

Beautiful atmosphere on gracious front porch. The lobster bisque is fantastic, service is great. We were warmly welcomed by the owner and the chef. This is a great choice for a romantic meal or celebration. We are nee neighbors and will return soon.

Our favorite local restaurant by far. The quality of everything on the menu is top notch. My wife loves the crostini and burrata appetizer, the Cobb salad is outstanding.  I love Stromboli's but no one seems to make it well. Ron's has the best one I've had. Friendly service too.

Went a couple of times before the pandemic. I waited about 5-10 mins on both times which was okay. There are very limited tables/seats to dine in so the staff defaultly packs your order in a bag. Their packaging is way too excessive, plastic bags here and there. On both visits, there were items that were incorrect or missing. It got sorted out when i went to the cashier but could be avoided altogether considering they have a lot of staff checking the orders before it gets to you. I suggest you check your order before you head out if you are not dining in.

Chickenjoy as expected was juicy and crispy and just how it tasted in the philippines. Spaghetti, peach mango pie and palabok was ok. Pineapple juice too sweet, like full of sugar. Gravy complimented the crispy skin of chickenjoy.

Some people said the food is overpriced. I think it is just about right. Every chicken fastfood outlet has their distinctive taste and every person has their personal preferences so i won't compare this to popeye's or kfc. 

Will i be back? Definitely but will wait for the kingsway branch to be open. South side branch is too far.

I shop at this store 4x a week after work. Shopping at this store is always a pleasure.   I really like the fact that they always have plenty of cashiers to get me out quickly. Key word CASHIERS, not self service registers.  I feel very strongly against using those machines.  
The store is always clean, the people are always friendly and I've simply not had a bad experience here.   
The pharmacist is fantastic, personalized care and attention.  
I love this store.

I'm from San Antonio, TX and have lived here since 2018. Ever since I moved here I've been on a non-stop search for some great Mexican food that I'm used to finding easily in Texas. I finally found it today. I ordered the Enchiladas Verdes with an Asada & Carnita taco, and my friends got the steak nachos. I got one chicken and one cheese enchilada and they were both perfectly cooked and seasoned. The refried beans were also perfect. Rice was good but a little bland. (Still 5 stars) This place is 20 minutes from where I live across the bridge but I'm more than excited to eat here again and again. The horchata was also amazing and you can tell they didn't use the powdered! The hot sauce that came with the tacos I'm guessing is habanero based? Also spicy and delicious!

I have never had a bad meal here. They've got a rotating cocktail menu - there's always something good - and they have happy hour. We get the ahi tuna or deviled eggs for appetizers. I usually get the prime rib but the filet is great too. Loaded baked potato and port wine mushrooms are my favorite sides. Very nice large bar area and accommodating staff. Fleming's is still better, but this is a little less expensive and a little more casual.

I don't know what is different or going on with Ulele but this was the worse meal  we ever had here. The wild rice that the started this week was a bust and my husband had the roasted chicken with light tomato lemon sauce and he didn't like it. We never leave food but tonight we are that's says a lot.

If you're looking for healthy delicious food with organic, vegan, and gluten-free options, this is your place. If none of these sound familiar or interesting to you, this is still your place. That's how much I love the food and experience at Craft Kafe. 
 
Based on my friend's last experience here, she recommended that we go here for brunch. We came hungry and slightly indecisive so naturally we ordered a few things. She ordered the mediterranean toast and breakfast pizza with a side of coffee. I ordered a make your own omelette, avocado toast and some amazing orange blossom iced tea. Oh yeah, I can't forget the apple baked goody I ordered to go.  My gigantic omelette came with gluten-free bread and a side of breakfast potatoes. The two of us sat outside feasting on enough plates that look as if four people were eating. I have no regrets... everything was amazingly delicious. I left happy and stuffed!!

You can sit inside or out side. There is an outside walk up window to order coffee. The outside seating area is fur baby friendly. 

I will definitely be back next time I visit Saint Pete! And if the owners are reading this, Please build one in Orlando, Florida

Very nice dimly lite restaurant in a newish trendy area of Tampa. The service was above average & our waiter really knew the menu quite well. The mozzarella cart was delicious as well as the appetizers & dinner. They also have a great tequila selection which is my favorite so that was an added bonus. Definitely worth the prices & expect to invest time it's not a quick in & out restaurant it's a experience. I recommend & will go back again.
Hoagies are delicious. We recently tried the breakfast sandwiches and they were amazing too. Scrapple cooked perfectly!

Tuesday is Mother Daughter time.  Decided we would overcome our Covid fear and eat out.  We walked in and they were busy, waited a good ten minutes before being asked about being seated.  Sat in a booth right next to other people back to back. I'm a frontline worker and that made me a tad nervous.  Florida rules, my choice.  Should have ate outside.  Ordered the 2 for $22 and a Strawberry Margarita (on special!).  Our meal a Cheeseburger with tots, Bourbon Chicken with steamed Broccoli and mashed potatoes, and the salad bar.  Who doesn't love this salad bar!!?  Unfortunately our appetizer pretzels came out charcoal the first time (picture is the second try, much better).  Cheeseburger was good, slightly leaning towards rare more than medium rare.  The bourbon chicken was overcooked and dry, couldn't eat most of the chicken because it was like straw.  When asked by cashier how the meal was, we let him know and the manager and GM came out and apologized.  They offered to comp the meal, but I pay for my meal, plus service was great!  Kudos to the staff and management, we'll be back to try again because of service.  I did have a craving for Dessert Chocolate Lava cake, they comped it, thanks.

New favorite place ever! The service is impeccable, the food is AHMAZING!! The live band was fun. Played a diverse set from Zydeco to popular .
We had the pretzels, beer cheese, schnitzel, veal brats and the drunken pig pulled pork. Beer on tap is cold cold cold  
The people that go are super friendly. Dog friendly, people friendly, family friendly. Plus, it's next to Pizza Delicious!!! Best of both worlds

While the music was great and that was what we were there for, the service is horrible to non-existent. This was my second visit, I've never been served worse food anywhere, twice! This venue is way overpriced on food & drink. I don't think anyone that works here cares about how this place runs. Food is a total mess. The seating is very misleading. Our VIP seats were NOT elevated as shown &  they were behind a barrier a short person (myself) would be unable to see over. Music is great, but, I repeat, the food is bad and shockingly overpriced. Eat before you come.
Half my order was missing. Second time this has happened and they have stolen my money. People working in the drive thru may be pulling a scam ripping people off. Won't be going back again. Beware.

I found it very amazing that our waitress recognized me and hubby even after 3 years, WOW!!! We used to get delivery very often when we lived closer to the restaurant delivery range. Since we moved out of their range, we order far less than used to. Today we decided to go back. The restaurant is the same 3 years ago but with seasonal holiday decorations added. 

Asian Bamboo House served Chinese, Japanese, and Thai cuisines. Many restaurants lack one or the other when they mix cuisines. For example, many fusion restaurant is ok with Chinese food, but their Thai or Japanese are lacking or vice versa. ABH is actually pretty balanced, well at least in my opinion, their Chinese, Japanese, and Thai cuisines are all pretty good. 

Our stables are pizza rolls, scallion pancake, shrimp with broccoli, tom yum soup, and mongolian beef. 
Their scallion pancake crust taste like it was deep fried than pan-fried. Tom yum soup is the BEST in NE Philly, not better than the authentic Thai but is way better than other fusion restaurants. 

ABH also serves some very interesting desserts such as fried green tea ice cream, bomba, exotic bomba, coppa pina collatta etc..... 

P.S. It is not authentic cuisines!! It is more Americanized.

3.5 but I always round up if I can't decide. 

We had reservations for 6:00 on a Friday night. We arrived on time and were seated on the 4th floor quickly. Our drinks arrived in a timely fashion, and our waitress was attentive to our needs before ordering. 

I ordered the bacon cheeseburger and fries, while my wife ordered the rattlesnake pasta. I asked for medium well, but the burger had spots of medium inside. The fries were average - would have been better with some added seasoning. My wife's pasta was VERY good, with just the right amount of spice. For dessert, we chose the red velvet cake. Very good, and was enough to share. 

Overall, I think the price is a little high. Mainly due to the prices for drinks. For a restaurant that wants to compete in this price range, I think the burger could have been better. Everyone there was very nice, and the service is on time if you need a quick dinner before going to a show/concert. However, because of all the choices downtown, the jury is still out on whether we'll go back.

Safer Chimney
All our crew members live this place!!!! The owners are super cool and friendly!!! Try the Margherita pizza and cheese bread

Wide noodle Pad Se Ew!!!!!! There's two types of Thai restaurants in this town: ones that serve tiny, flavorless, not worth the calories pad se ew noodles and ones that serve the right kind. If you like Siam Square's version you will like this. And it's 2 minutes from my house instead of I can't count that many minutes because I'm so hungry minutes. Please eat here so I can have my noodles!

28.00 for two cheesesteaks and fries. Nothing special. Long wait time after order. Stick with a local pizza shop, like Pizza Star or Julios in the same shopping center. They are less expensive , faster and WAY better. Won't be going back and won't recommend.

Growing up a Gentilly denizen in Edgewood Park, McKenzie's Chicken In a Box was a semi-regular meal offering at our house.  Although not my favorite chicken as a child, my parents liked it; therefore, my sister and I had no other choice for dinner when it was served.  Don't get me wrong, as there was absolutely nothing wrong with this chicken.  However, as kids, my sister and I were always wanting the television advertised chicken from Popeyes and/or Church's chicken. But I digress.

Frying chicken can get messy, especially if you don't have a deep fryer and you are using your trusty cast iron frying pan.  McKenzie's chicken "looks" more like home made chicken than all the other local offerings.  The pieces seem to be a little smaller, but perhaps they use smaller birds.  Who knows.  I find the flavor to be good but the skin is sometimes inconsistently cooked.  At times it can be nice and crispy, but sometimes it can be a little chewy.

The sides dishes are decent at best, with the dirty rice being my favorite of the limited options.  Now that I live in Lakeview, this is not my go to place for fried chicken.

Four of us were here on Monday. Drinks were great and they have an excellent selection of wine. Two of us split the hangar steak with a pesto sauce, one had the boneless fried chicken, and I had the pork gnocchi. All of the plates left the table cleaned so I guess you figured out the food was excellent. Service was also great. I will definitely be back again!

It was good until i saw the dude playing with his phone with his gloves on behind the counter.   I was at the sushi bar and saw him hide it...so he knows it's gross.  Sorry....but truthfully he also crossed his arms exposing his pits to the gloves...then worked some sushi over.  Sorry again.
Love this new place and the great pizza and salads they offer. They also have a rewards program you can download on your phone.

My husband and I were very very heart broken abour our dinner tonight. Ordered broccoli bites and there was only 5 of them, COVERED in salt... We like salt but that was way too much. So much salt our hands are literally swollen from it. The fry oil tasted very old. Onion rings would have been good if they didn't add the pound of salt and used differnt dry oil. My corned beef special was ok, could have used a hearty bread rather than just aliced bread. My husband's tuna hoagie barely had tuna on it. I hate giving a bad review. But the money really wasnt spent well. Better places to go in our opinion. Very nice staff though!
Best food ever! Surprise my boyfriend here for his birthday and it is a night to remember!

Hands down my favorite Mexican establishment in Tucson! Don't let the fact that it's a food truck fool you, their food is top notch! And their prices are unbeatable for the amount of food you get for the low price point. My favorite thing off their menu has to be their chicken tinga tostada! Their chicken is so tender and the flavors are so delicious. It's topped with an obscene amount of delicious avocados, lettuce, and cotija cheese! The amount of food that they pile on is probably equivalent to two tostadas! And all their tacos are also delicious and you have a choice between flour or corn tortillas. Their green salsa is packed with flavor in addition to MORE bite-sized avocados in the salsa. Oh man, I'm salivating just thinking of their food. During these weird times, I'm happy to support small businesses especially when you get such superbly delicious food in exchange! Make sure you give them a try!

Good food. Ordered takeout during pandemic and restaurant was PACKED. Would not have ordered if I knew they weren't taking social distancing seriously. There are better Mexican restaurants for less cost, but the ambiance is nice at this restaurant, so it depends on what you're looking for.
Great burger! White American cheese was so good! Very reasonably priced for as good as they are.
Great food, mostly great service. Servers are hit or miss. Very busy on Sundays but that's a good sign obviously. A lot of menu options
Today was our first-time visit to Datz. We thought we'd give it a try after reading about it on-line. WOW!!!  The lunches we ordered beat all expectations!  Spec-tac-ular!!!

In a nutshell - nothing to write home about. Food was fine, service subpar, location great, price average. 3 of us ordered 3 appetizers and 3 entrees. When  ordering, u asked about peanuts in a dish and was told "it might" have peanuts to which I said I better order something else then. We went on to have Rangoon, chicken satay, spring rolls) and they were all good but nothing special. 2 of them came with peanut sauces or peanut oil and the server did not warn me or offer other sauces and wasn't around for me to ask for another. My green curry was fine, again good but nothing too special. The other 2 dishes we ordered were wide rice noodle dishes with different names, but came out looking and tasting exactly the same. Overall food was fine but wish the server was more accommodating and sensitive to food allergies and checked in with our table after bringing the food.

Great food and good drinks!!! I came here with a friend last week and the waitress was very helpful and told us about all the deals going on that night. Drinks were cheap and had me feeling good. I ordered the chicken wings and fries and they were phenomenal. I'll definitely be back

Got takeout and the food was so sub par from the meals I have had in the restaurant I don't want to ever go back even after covid.  Wish I would have took a pic.  I got the oriental chicken salad and my husband got the bang bang chicken and shrimp.  My salad had barely 5 pieces of chicken and none of the usual toppings.  His looked like dog barf with a blob of rice in the middle. Cafeteria food was only thing to describe it.  Never going back.  Horrible curbside service which ended up being that we had to go inside and sort thru multiple bags everywhere on tables waiting to go out.

I feel really ashamed coming here and not getting gumbo but.... their other menu items are equally as amazing as I've *heard* their gumbo is. My partner did get their vegan gumbo (doesn't count lol) and I got their crawfish pasta. Let me tell you.... some of the most tasty pasta I've ever had and I am a pasta lover!!! Crawfish isn't even season right now and the pasta was still sooooooo good so I was really impressed. Very flavorful and creamy. I also got a side of their jambalaya which i wasn't too much of a fan of, but I won't hold it against them. For dessert i got their bread pudding with whiskey sauce....... OH MY GOD.. AMAZING!!!! I started doing the happy dance when I took the first bite. Only place whose bread pudding rivals theirs that I've personally had is Pappedeaux (if you're from Texas you know). We walked in for dinner maybe 30 mins before close and i still felt like my server was attentive and the food quality didn't suffer. Its important to note that we were waiting for about 20-30 mins outside prior so keep that in mind before visiting. This place is very popular amongst natives from New Orleans and tourists alike. When I come back to New Orleans I will definitely have to come back here and this time i will be sure to try the gumbo and other popular items they serve... all of their food looks really good to be honest. I feel like there's something for everyone here. It is a smaller establishment though so if you're bringing large groups bear in mind. Probabl

Have you finally made it to the Big Easy to sample some of Cafe Beignet's legendary beignets, only to be completely discouraged by the ridiculously long lines you'll need to wait in to score your zillion calorie fix?  Fret not, little camper!  There's a simple solution to your problem - go to one of the secondary locations they've opened in recent years.

The good news - they make the same amazing beignets at this location; they're just as crunchy, just as gooey, and they covered with exactly the same quantity of powdered suger.

The bad news - while the lines here are shorter than at the Mother Ship, they don't move amazingly fast here either (I don't think they have enough staff working the counter).

To be fair, the net effect of visiting this location instead of the Mother Ship is you won't be waiting anywhere  near as long for your beignets.  Once you've got them in hand, you can devour them while planning the physical activity you'll need to work 'em off ;-)

After hearing about this pizza from so many people, I knew I had to try it. I was honestly afraid of being disappointed. I never went to the old shop, so the new location was my first experience with Pizzeria Beddia, so I can't speak for how it compares to before. However, I can state with confidence that this was some of the best pizza I have ever had. It was completely worth the wait for the reservation and worth the cash for the pizzas. 

The crust is per perfection. It holds up when you pick up the slice, but it also isn't too thick. The crust actually has flavor! I usually eat the crust of my pizza first as it's my least favorite and I want to save the best part, the toppings in my opinion, for last. Not here! Every part of the pizza is equally good. I can actually taste the olive oil in the crust. 

Flavor wise, wow! The spicy pizza is excellent. It has real heat. Thai chili's a cooked into the red sauce and there are pickled peppers on the top. It's savory, spicy, and crazy delicious. We were lucky enough to be there when they had the special ramp pizza a few weeks ago. This one was much heavier and oily and richer. It was a great contrast to the spicy pizza. I don't think I would have enjoyed it as much on it's own though. My husband felt it was the superior pizza since he's not a big spicy fan. 

For two people you certainly don't need two pizzas. However, I am glad we did that so we could try two completely different flavors. We also had delicious left overs for lun

My girlfriend and I came here on a recommendation from a friend. We rode our bikes right up the Riverwalk to it and got a table. Raymond was very friendly and helped with recommendations for food and drinks. We had the prosciutto flatbread and it was phenomenal. I definitely recommend this place to anyone who loves outdoor an atmosphere with great food.

Me and a friend came to Daisy Mae's to have some cocktails and catch up and celebrate the new move down the road. Upon entering we just sat ourselves at the bar and waited around 15 mins for our first round when the store was completely empty. We are the only two people in this establishment. We ordered some chips and salsa as we waited for our cocktails which came out before we even got our waters. The chips tasted fishy, and the salsa tasted weird. As we were waiting for someone to come take our next round order the underaged hostess in a striped dress walked behind the bar and poured herself a glass of jack daniels and filled it with coke and went and hid it behind the silverware station. Then what I assume is the bar manager or general manager was joking around with the crew about drinking alcohol before the shift. And now the underage girl stealing alcohol is doing what seems like training a new girl.  Also the tequila was very watered down. Small menu but great food tho.




UPDATE:

We told the manager about the girl stealing and drinking alcohol and they didn't care. Her friend lied and covered for her and when we were leaving they were laughing about it.

This place is a gem.  Absolutely great food and value.  Prices are very reasonable given the quality and quantity.  Every BBQ dish is great.  I usually try whatever meat special they are pushing.  Warning: the pork steaks are humongous.  So many great sides to choose from (although they do run out from time to time).  They have some of the best sweet potato fries.  The corn nuggets and Mac and cheese bites are also some favorites. This place is in a campground, but in Cahokia/Sauget IL, which is the last place I expect to find a campground, so the whole experience of coming to this place is odd.  It used to be barely a room of a building, but their great food is the basis of their success and they keep adding on.  You'll wonder how you ever found this place, but you'll be glad you did.  It's a must try.

Went for my birthday dinner.  I had vegetarian pho that was absolutely delicious ‼. Vegetable dumplings were really good also.  Service was prompt and friendly.  I would highly recommend this restaurant and can't wait to return

Update: They're open. Thanks to Maverick for his professionalism and help remedying the situation.

So... does this mean indefinitely? We placed an online order last night and arrived to this sign and it's still there this morning. Hopefully they'll refund my money and points I used for the order. That's too bad if they are closing. Love the Cheesesteak sandwich.

Friends don't take friends to Herbie's. And yet, they do. So, I keep coming back, even though I'm consistently underwhelmed and overcharged. 

Generally, stuff is just way too salty. They try hard to be "interesting - as if adding lots of surprise elements would somehow justify the inflated prices. The most annoying thing is how they fall down on the basics. I ordered a hamburger for lunch "medium rare." It came to me raw, so I had to send it back (generally not my m.o.). It came back overcooked. 

Come on guys, it's a hamburger for chrissake. Do you know how to cook a hamburger? 

Nothing here is memorable, except the pretentious murmur of the power elite, singing their hymns of self-satisfaction. Maybe I'm just biased, but the whole scene grosses me out.
This place is pretty overpriced and the sandwiches are very mediocre, but service was quick though.

I would stop here on my annual trip to Nashville and look forward to it every year. However this time around it was absolutely terrible! I think ownership must of changed or something. I use to be able to order a half torta and it was this size of my head. This last time it was so tiny and more like a taco salad since the wasn't very much bread. The spicy chicken also lacked the usual spiciness and had no flavor. My girlfriend had the acapulco bowl which was very underwhelming and had very little steak. Maybe they are being stingy because of the pandemic? Whatever the reason it is not acceptable for the prices they charge. Originally intended to go in and order tacos but $4.25 for one taco! That is highway robbery and double the price you would pay anywhere else. I will never return and would suggest anyone else pass on this place.

Bomb ass vegan pizza! And the garlic knots with vegan ranch is just heavenly. I'm so happy to see more vegan spots pop up in Reno and sizzle pie does not disappoint! My favorite is the buffalo 666 if you like it hot ! They have a full bar too!

Great place to eat!!! You should try it. 
I ordered aguachile, enchiladas and chicken strips. Everything was delicious. The plates are HUGE! 

The service was fantastic. Juan was our waiter. He was very nice, polite and fast. 
I will definitely come back soon.

Best pizza in the area, and up there with New York City (yes I am a snob).

And they deliver!

Seriously, crust is perfect and the cheese is of a higher quality than other places. 

Sauce sweet but not too sweet.

This is what good pizza is supposed to be like.

Now overtakes Phil's, which is now a distant second place, for our family.

Fries were also liked, has thickish coating, kind of like Burger King's.

Chicken tenders, meh. Someone commented it is probably jus reheated frozen Tyson's.

The reviews did not lie with this establishment (a fancy word for this place :) BAM, Pauly himself greets you with a big smile and ask's you whjat you need.. no need to order a double in this place.. they have outstanding cocktails and AMAZING food! Do yourself a favor and try this spot.. CLEAN, friendly and a much needed go to for an 11 o'clock lunch... keep up the great work Pauly and staff.....

Good place and friendly,  efficient service.
Fried shrimp was excellent and juicy. I also really enjoyed the Shrimp Tacos.

Fries were okay but the fried corn on the cob (not battered) was really good.

My sister had Stuffed Avocado with tuna and seaweed on a bed of ruce. She ate ia all.

Would definitely recommend the Shrimp Tacos and Fried Shrimp.  Also, the Onion Straws and Char-grilled Oysters.

One more block and you'll find dining options with a water view.

Decided to try a new Chinese takeout place since it had good reviews and it did not disappoint! I got the chicken and veggies which was delicious and the veggies were very fresh and yummy. The inside was so cute and clean. The lady at the counter was so sweet and gave me free cookies! Would definitely come back again!
Great hidden spot. Awesome music. Staff is great! From the bar staff to the door guy are personable and respectful. Loved it!

The Bean Gallery is one of my favorite cafés! They carry your standard coffee fare along with a really exciting collection of herbal tea. They have loose leaves--if I can remember correctly: lavender, sage, mint, lemon + ginger, rooibos, and a few others--that you can mix and match. They have at least a hundred books; two bathrooms; both table, bar, and couch seating; good lighting; plenty of outdoor area; and a solid mix of savory and sweet foods available. It kind of just feels like a bright, quiet place to have a drink and get some work done. In the mornings, there are a lot of dogs that come in as their owner orders a drink. The baristas all have good music taste. The customers all look like they are cool people and I always want to make friends but don't want to seem weird (re: quiet). Anyways, The Bean Gallery is open early til late, has good energy and refreshments, and isn't pretentious. Appreciate having somewhere to get some work done that isn't home.
Good coffee. Good pastries. A few fun items and fancy cakes too. Can't go wrong - love this little spot!

My dish was too salty
:( 
Aftertaste was sour from our shrimp creole 
But the plantains taste amazing !!
Hella heavy seasoning. 


Price was decent 


Vibe was chill, not a lot of people inside when we were there.

Won't eat here anymore. I have an aging mother who doesn't get around too well that I would take there frequently because it was her favorite place until COVID happened. Then we ordered to pick up once a week to help keep the business going. We did have to re- heat the food when we got home. But we were trying to help. Anyway when you were allowed to open with limited seating we tried to make a reservation for 2 only to be told you aren't doing reservations for only 2.  I even asked on your FB post if you were doing reservations for 2 . Nobody from Carluccis responded but a customer did and said they make reservations for 2 all of the time every Saturday.  Can't have a sickly mother waiting around a crowded front of the restaurant for a table with a virus that affects the elderly more severely.  She just wanted it to feel normal again.  So it seems you have forgotten what customer service is all about.

This restraunt seemed very chaotic because they screwed my order up twice and by that time I said screw it all and just took what I was given. It might be the most over priced and over rated food I've had. Would definitely not recommend

The absolute bomb-diggity. Came in with a number of friends just based on the name and we ordered 8 different dishes. Every dish was homey, excellent, filling, and tasty! If you go, don't forget to grab some Kvass--where else are you going to find kvass in Florida???

We normally love this place but tonight we chose to dine in and it was very disappointing, first orders kept being messed up, then after 25 minutes of waiting we get our order the wings looked like they were on a diet very small like they were for a kid!  Not sure if we'll be back

Opened recently in the old MCL cafeteria space. I wanted to try it out as there aren't any places that serve South Indian dosas close by. Tried the Chettinad Dosa and some wada. They were good. Not excellent. Plan to go back and try a few more things. Interesting that they give you bottled water instead a glass.

Before the change in name and management I had come here fairly often.  It was a nice night out.  Since then the quality has taken a major nosedive.  The food is almost the same at times, a shadow of what used to be at worst.  The atrocious service is the worst of the worst.  After waiting over an hour for hibachi after being sat down, I thought that was bottom of the barrel.  I was corrected after attempting to order pick up.  I was yelled at on the phone and told to, and I quote "don't call back here again" when checking after it was over 20 minuets late with no updates.  They refused to take my name for which order was mine, demanding a phone number, then quite literally threw a wrong order at me. I will never step foot here again and no one else should as well as far as I'm concerned.  I should have taken the obvious frustration of the delivery workers as a sign.

Got delivery through Caviar. This spot was recommended by colleagues who boasted how fresh the fish is so I was very excited to try, but was sadly disappointed. Ordered pork sumo buns, Yaki Udon Stir Fry, nigiri: salmon, yellowtail, ikura, uni, otoro. 

Pork sumo buns- least favorite. A lot of meat though! Sadly I didn't end up not eating the meat because it didn't taste good... there was a distinct taste to it that I just didn't like. I liked that it came with pickled radish and helped cover that taste I didn't like. 

Yaki udon stir fry- added $2 for veggies and tofu. A lot of tofu which is nice. Pretty plain though. Would not order again either. 

Nigiris- not bad! A bit pricy for 1 small nigiri but I enjoyed the otoro the most. Uni had a lotttt of uni but didn't taste super fresh. No fault of the restaurant though, uni is always a toss up. 

Overall, I am thinking maybe there are such good reviews because of the rolls which I didn't get. If I order from here again I'll try the rolls but otherwise I'm going to get my noodles and nigiris somewhere else.
Great take-out options during the pandemic! Very clean and friendly. The Thai tea is really good and I like the cashew nut chicken with it. Also great mango sticky rice when it's in season!
Fave place to grab a good grouper sandwich! Service is great and fast pace . Everyone is super friendly.

Cool, cafeteria style place with a bar. Pizza was delicious! Bartender was friendly and made sure we were hydrated! My wife and I tend to try pizza whenever we travel even if the City isn't known for pizza. This was another great find!

We've been to Carlucci's a handfull of times over the years each time I hope it get's better. It's clear the ownership is making an investment in the facilities. I don't think you can match the outdoor fine dining atmosphere. I also think the menu is great for a high end Italian/Steak/Seafood restaurant. The service is very good as well. I gave it 3 stars instead of 5 because in my experience the kitchen doesn't live up to the menu. We've ordered all over the menu from pasta to steak to seafood. All I can say is that we haven't had a consistent experience with some appetizers/entrees were great others we were disappointed. For the atmosphere and menu choices you should take a shot.

Yianni's has been around for as long as I can remember, and it's been in the same location on Whyte Avenue since at least the mid-1990's, and probably longer than that! When I was looking for a restaurant to have a nice dinner with friends in the holiday season, Yianni's came up in our searches and we decided to give it a shot. The restaurant has a perfect dinner atmosphere, with great décor and a few different levels of tables. I made a reservation for Saturday night dinner, but the restaurant was pretty quiet (probably due to the cold weather). We decided as a table to try the Olympus platter, with a few extra pieces added, and it was so good! The lemon potatoes were a clear stand-out, as was the lamb. All of the dishes felt fresh and were prepared well, and we ate until we were totally stuffed.  The Olympus platter is sized for four, but it easily fed our group of six, and we had a little bit of food left over. There was a belly dancer there, and we got some table side entertainment.  She asked a few of our dining partners to get up and dance with her, which was great fun. I think you can decline the dancing if it's not your thing, but why not enjoy? Overall our meal was delicious, and I'm glad I finally got to try Yianni's. There's a gorgeous patio for warmer weather, and I can't wait to check it out in the summer.

I test breakfast spots by the quality of their Benedict and Crown and Bull did not disappoint! It was so fresh and they even have a hollandaise of the day, it was Parmesan basil when I went. 
Went back later at night for a cocktail and their old fashioned didn't disappoint. Definitely recommend trying this place out!

Oh man. The food here was phenomenal. My brother and I were driving across the country and figured we would grab some bbq in St Louis. Did some searching and found this place. 
We were blown away by the food and we eat a ton of bbq, have a smoker, etc etc. 
raviolis are LIT, sauces are phenomenal, meats were excellent, bakes beans were on point. 
I would absolutely make a point of coming here if I ever went near St Louis again

Ordered 2 cases of roasted Green Chile, show up to pick them up, they were not ready.  Asked if we could wait til the next day, said ok, they called and said they sold them to someone else.  Ordered same thing at Golden Valley store, called to see if they were ready, they said sorry, but we might only be able to give you 1, maybe. I like Raley's , but you need to do something about the Green Chile situation.  I know they are becoming popular, but is that really an excuse for failing to fill the order?

My boyfriend and I went back again. We both tried the south philly sandwich. It tasted similar to some nice cuts of pork roast. The cashew sauce on top was amazing, it tasted even better than real cheese. One con to the sandwich is that the bread wasn't very fresh as it could be. However we still loved it, can't wait to come back!

If I could give it zero stars I would. My girlfriend and I went here and got a pizza to share. It was actively worse than any frozen pizza from a grocery store. The crust was a hard pre-made disk and they clearly just sprinkled a bag of shredded cheese and some tomato slices on top. They had the audacity to call this a margarita pizza.

 It's been almost five months since I had this pizza and my girlfriend and I still reference how bad it is as our benchmark for talking about bad food and restaurants. We will say things like "oh was the food worse or better than *that* pizza?" the answer is always "oh this food was bad but still better than that pizza". I still am baffled about how someone made this and was like "yeah we can put it on a menu". Despicable.

Food was pretty good. I ordered samosa chaat (was average), the goat curry (delicious), punjabi kadhi (also very good), dal chana (was okay), gobi paratha (first time having this but I did not enjoy it), gulab jamun (yum), and mango lassi.

I ordered online directly from their website. I asked the kitchen for my order when I got there but it didn't seem like my order was sent to the kitchen yet - the cashier from the grocery store printed out my order then sent it back. So I don't think ordering online for pick up really saved me anytime vs going and ordering at the kitchen.

This was a great dog friendly find.  They have water bowls ready for their fur guests and kindly welcome them.  The menu is good bar good.  If you're looking for Cajun, Creole or fresh fish, this isn't the best place to visit, however if you want a great chicken sandwich or burger and you want to bring your dog along, this is the place!

Worst place I've been here. Bagels are a disappointment and all staff was extremely rude to customers. Prices are too high for what they have, and they allow people to be in there without social distancing. The virus doesn't come around you if you are packed shoulder to shoulder and eating? Ridiculous. Don't waste your money here

I wanted something different and unique that I can't get anywhere else when I came to visit Nashville and my friend this is what pulled up on the yelp and man, am I ever so thankful that it did!

I loved that you get to sit in a huge table that can seat 12 and you just don't know who else will be there with you.  That's truly when we no longer become stranger but friends at this point.  After the food got passed, we talked like we've known each other for our whole lives.  We got the fried chicken, greens, meatloaf, ribs and that was just for starters.  It was all wonderful and everything was like your momma would make.  The people at our table were mentioning that the biscuits were better than Biscuit Love (I can't be a judge since I hadn't been there, but I can only say that must be a huge compliment). The banana pudding at the end was a sweet way to end the meal.  

Love, love, love everything about this place.  What I love most was that at the end of the meal, we were all connected as friends and there's nothing better than that!
Visiting a neighborhood bar as a local is always fun. SCOTT was great at recommending and whipping us up some great cocktails. Cool dive bar with crafty cocktails.

They have ROACHES and WATERBUGS EVERYWHERE. The employees need more training than what they have, not to mention that they look a WRECK. The chicken tenders are expired, and the buns have mold on them. They never change the ice cream until they run out. The buffet line is never emptied, just put in a cooler. COMPLETELY DISGUSTING. I use to work there and i just wanted to let it be known because that place shouldn't still be there. The employees never care to completely clean at. 

Just an update. they are closed for good

I love the place. The food is always fantastic. The staff is warm and friendly... and most have been there for years. 

Any day of the week, they'll offer a mimosa. Gotta love it!

We've been back a few times since my initial review. We've even had their ice cream finally. There is truly nothing to complain about here. We've tried a few different sandwiches - both cold and hot - and everything we've tried has been delicious. The bread is my favorite, it so soft and fresh. I don't think I've tasted something that I haven't like yet as far as the deli area goes. And what's not to love when the serve your sandwich in the shape of a heart? That shows some serious love.

The Icecycle creamery side of it: I love that they let you taste the options that they have. I have to say it is certainly the most unique flavors of any place in town. So many flavors that you would never imagine going well together, taste amazing. We recently went in to try their coffee cheesecake flavor that we saw on Facebook. I think it might be the best ice cream I have ever had. We even went back for more. 

Overall - still a solid place for lunch and desert. We'll certainly keep coming back even though it's on the other end of town from us. I love the atmosphere, the employees are always friendly and greet you as you come in, and the food is delicious. Great place and I hope they stick around for a long time.

Normally, this place is an easy decision for me and I do enjoy their food which is why this is not a one star review but rather a warning...   My go to meals are their lunch specials (souvlaki and salad), and souvlaki platter for dinner.  I eat their gyros and other dishes from time to time but I really enjoy their souvlaki.  I also love their Greek salad with that scoop of potato salad..so good.

That said, the last time I went I got a terrible case of food poisoning. I am not sure if they are trying to stretch the life of the meat or they used a sub prime piece or poor hygiene, but I was very disappointed by that experience.  I believe it was the meat since it was the only thing my wife did not share with me and I was the only one to get sick. It was so painful and terrible of an experience, it really makes me reconsider going back again ever.  I'm lucky my kid didn't want to eat any that night because I can't imagine what that would have been like.  I hope no one else got sick that night from that.

This place is a can't miss! Some of the best Mexican food in town. 

Got to try the Campechano burrito today and it was excellent. Melts cheese held all the ingredients together. Couldn't say enough positive things about this place and the owner. He's super friendly and knowledgeable of the area. 

Everything is  super fresh and this is why it may take ~10 minutes for an order. You can taste how fresh and flavor the food is. Lots of love and care going into each order. 

Be sure to check this place out if on the north side.

Food was delicious....should've been my first stop!!! Next time I come back home....this will be my first stop! The good was fresh and hot....the waitress was very polite and knowledgeable about the menu.
Rude rude rude lil kids...disappointed in myself that I didn't cancel my order......such rude rude lil kids working for their parents

Tucked away on the fourth floor of the Fairlaine Hotel is Ellington's which boasts a retro 20's ambiance. While we weren't around in the 20s, we weren't getting 1920s pre-depression realness, unless Hotel restaurants of the era were the same vanilla-seen one- seen them all - average.

From there, things picked up. A delightful mezcal old fashioned was a new trick on an old treat. 

The food was average at best. Nothing really interesting or noteworthy, and we really wanted it to be. With some much going on in the food scene on Nashville, we were really hoping for something special. This was our second attempt at dining here. The first time we couldn't because the heat was out, and we were directed to the deli in the lobby. In that visit they were out of most items. 

This hotel has so much promise. The live music that night was great. Emily Otteson and her co-hort were amazing and brought the room to life.

Long time fan of rize in the iron works complex, and when I heard that they were opening in the yard in fishers I was happy to hear that as well, because who doesn't like options of good food? And if you don't, why are you on this app mostly food focused? Just something to consider 
This is a beautiful new space that is modern but not sterile, the service is awesome and it's great they have more space to spread out and have more people inside at once.
Rize has one of my favorite bloody Mary's, the flavor is fresh and not too heavy on the mix, and they put just the right amount of horse radish in. The salad on top is unique as well, with a stuffed olive and pickled onions and tasty cheeses.
As for food it's brunch and lunch, brunch is my go to so when visiting I got the eggs Benedict, tasty on top of and English muffin, ham, and hollandaise sauce. I love this place and having it so close to my apartment!
Such delicious burgers! Might be our new favorite! Big portions and we loved the view and the happy hour drinks only 2 dollars!

We live blocks from here and have been wanting to try this place out for a long time.  Covid squashed our plans for a little while.  My man friend went golfing earlier in the day, so dinner plans were pushed back, we wound up calling about 30 minutes from closing.  They told us to come on over.  The food, atmosphere, and service was 5 star.  Had escargot, sea bass, and New York strip, delicious!  Our server Dee, was more than accommodating.  GREAT FOOD, GREAT SERVICE!  We will be back!  Thank you Beau and Mo's for our first great dinner during pandemic times.  Appropriately spaced from other diners.  So wonderful!  So.  Wonderful.  Thanks again!

Really enjoyed here. Great atmosphere. Waitress was great. Diverse drink list and draft beer selection. The food was really really good. We started with the venison chili, enjoyed it thoroughly. The burger was fantastic. Really tender. Roll was exceptional. And the fries, amazing. 

Would 100% recommend. Bit pricey. But good.

Customer service was great. The food is basic. Nothing different from other places to grab a bite. If you have a place you love choose it first. Check this one out if your passing by and just hungry. They're stingy with the dressing.

I came here for "312 Day" hosted by Goose Island and part of the event was a buffet of some of their standard items.  It was nice because all and all I was able to try their pulled pork, ribs, wings, and several sides.  The ribs and wings were both excellent.  I loved the seasoning of the dry rubbed wings--no sauce needed!  I do enjoy having a variety of sauces available with my BBQ and the Midwestern covered that.  A great southern-style white sauce and STL sweet bbq sauce. Based on the food alone I would come back. I'm a bbq enthusiast and while this isn't the best I've had it was good and the atmosphere is great.  High-Ceilings, big space with plenty of seating, a large bar with tons of seating, and a great outdoor space that will now be enjoyable as we head into baseball season and the summer months.  I've heard really great things about the burgers which is what I plan on trying next time I come back.  This is a great space to watch sports games and be a part of the downtown atmosphere with a large food menu to enjoy.
Awesome local BBQ place.  We are new to the area and we're so please to find good bbq close to our new neighborhood.  The ribs, pulled pork and corn casserole are our favs so far :)

First bad experience with Nicoletto's. Super disappointing. Both of our "build your own pasta" bowls were cold and dry, not enough sauce. Garlic bread was hard as a rock and burnt. Not sure why everything was so sub par this time around. Will think twice before ordering again.

I have always loved this restaurant on Main Street ever since it popped up. The service and friendly and ambience is fun for a group for just date night. The margaritas are very strong! Be warned! I loved the big menu and also great prices here. It's one of my fave Mexican joints in St. Charles! Seating is very limited with tables so you might be wait but its worth it! Only thing I don't like is the $1.00 they charge if you use a debit or credit card.
I am obsessed with the squash ravioli. I've eaten here several times and have had a lovely experience every time. You can tell the food is made fresh in house. One of our favorite Donelson spots.
Alexius was our server and did a great job! Awesome happy hour deals and she was right on top of things. Definitely one of the best places to sit outside and enjoy a few drinks!

If I could give this zero stars I would. I ordered for delivery and they forgot my garlic dipping sauce. Besides forgetting the sauce, the pizza they delivered was destroyed. All of the cheese was off of the pie. Very disappointed. When I called the store to have them bring me one back they made it seem like I was making a problem for calling them.
Pretzel was great, hot and fresh.  Service was fast and friendly.  Brisket was very tasty and the fries were double fried.
Order a chicken combo meal at daughter request. She complained the chicken died thirsty. Moisture came from temperatures of the sandwich.

This is a great little family owned Mediterranean restaurant in South City. I sat at the bar and ordered to buffalo chicken fries and cevapi. The woman who helped me was very friendly and gave good suggestions. She also offered me a water while I waited. It did take a little bit longer than I expected with only one other table there at the time but I wasn't in a hurry. The food ended up being really good my husband and I enjoyed it. The only small downside was the timing on the food coming out. The fries came out quite a bit earlier than the cevapi so they weren't as hot by the time we ate them but still delicious!

The pastries are 6/5 stars! The food is 3/5 stars, so we averaged here to a four. It's a great vibe spot to sit and sip tea, eat a pastry and people watch state st. The people are super nice and give out samples inside and the pastries are to die for. We actually came to eat here because of the sampled pastries. The food is not bad, but not great it was all just a little off... but definitely get some pastries!!
We stopped in after landing in Phily for dinner! Definitely a hidden gem... the hummus platter & mixed grill were amazing. We will be back.. don't let the outside fool you it's truly delicious

#45. Pra Ram Long Song. It has many different names at different restaurants, Showering Rama, Swimming Rama, it really doesn't matter - it's awesome and Pad Thai does an excellent job fusing both spinach and broccoli together.  Not to give all the glory to my beloved dish, I feel like Phad Thai is a good measure of a restaurant-if it's bad, stop and leave (kinda like a California roll at a sushi place). They do a fantastic job on the Pad Thai as well. 
Nice people doing the best they can in these crazy times.

I enjoyed our dinner here although we did end up getting stuck sitting on the side of the restaurant outside. I ordered the 420 tacos and really enjoyed them. Each taco had a huge piece of fish in each one, loved it. We ordered the fish dip to start and that was good but nothing amazing. Overall enjoyed the food so I am sure we will be back.
Great food and atmosphere! Had to waiting list so I sat in bar. Very busy and crowded. Hopping place.  Fast food delivery too.

Very nice place to eat 
Great nightly specials 
Good staff fun environment 
Danielle and Amber are 2 of the best people always having fun

I must give The Capital Grille 5 stars for their outstanding service with my group of 9 people. They were able to do separate checks which was a huge help! They even offered individual instead of sharable sides which was awesome! Everyone loved their food and this was a great pre-theater fancy dinner.
My only complaint was that I originally needed a table for 14 and they neglected to tell me upon making my reservation that any party over 11 people would be charged $100 per person.

Just had the Bourbon Barrel Aged Burundi Coffee. It's amazing! I was told to try out this place and so happy that I did. My husband and I came for breakfast and although it has a limited selection of breakfast food what we ordered was really good. I had a breakfast sandwich. English muffin, Canadian bacon, Munster cheese and egg over easy. My hubby had the breakfast tacos - Yummy!!  Need to come back in the evening!
Great atmosphere. Best food on Bourbon St. Rooftop bar. Excellent service. Love this place. Great menu selection. Isiah is the man.
Good healthy food.  We often order for our work catering.  I would say that the parking is tight and it is loud.  If you are doing take out then it is great !

Decided to order from Mangia during the initial Covid lockdown and was excited to come across them in one of my delivery apps. We had the gnocchi and chicken Alfredo, and both of them were really tasty! Extra marks to the gnocchi as it was homemade and went well with the pesto sauce which is an option. The Alfredo was also tasty, but maybe just a step below. Regardless, it is worth making a trip or ordering delivery - good stuff!

Stopped in for lunch while on a lacrosse torny..great place. Service was great-holly and Steve were very attentive. Wild boar sliders were delicious and so was the pizza. Great selection of beers as well.

This is one of my favorite Poké bowl places in Tampa Bay. So far, I've been to this location and the International Plaza location. They're both consistent. They both have the same premium fresh ingredients to choose from in your Poké bowl.  I typically choose the regular size bowl which comes with two scoops of your choice of proteins and any of the good variety of toppings that you desire. There are a few special toppings that come with an up charge. 

My favorite protein so far are the spicy salmon and the shrimp. My favorite sauces I like to use are a mixture of the O.G. and the spicy ginger. The service from my experience has always been courteous and quick since the selections are already fresh and in front of us. All they have to do is scoop them in your bowl and keep it moving. The responsibility of the flavors fall on the customer who chooses what goes into their own bowl. 

All in all, it's been a tasty experience!

Oh. My. Goodness. 
This (not so secret) secret chicken place is now going to be added to our take out rotation. 
Our first visit was on Thursday evening. We called it in and the gentleman that answered the phone was so pleasant and helpful. He let us know ahead of time to bring cash because the card machine was down. No problem. We ordered three orders of chicken fingers. Two chicken sandwiches. Chicken breast. Two orders of Malai bombs. And last but not least, an order of garlic naan buns. The location was very easy to find. When I walked in to Chapati's, I was very pleased with the space surrounding me.  Very chill. Very cool. I can't wait to take my family back to dine in so that we can enjoy an eat-in experience there. 
I wanted to add on the sugar cane juice that comes highly recommended, but it was out of season. I will definitely return to try it. 
The chicken (all tandoori, extra crispy) was amazing. Moist. Crispy. Perfect. The naan was fluffy and full of flavor. And the bombs were "the bomb"! 
I would highly recommend this place. I can't wait to return.

I've been here 5 or 6 times and it's really a hit or miss. The chicken cheesesteak, chicken nuggets, and fish sandwich are great (Blackbird's cheesesteak is still better). Shrimp nuggets and fries are okay. Meatball sub is decent but wouldn't recommend it.

Last night I got the golden tofu wrap which was completely inedible. I can usually choke down food even if it's not great, but this was just bad. The rice was undercooked, the tofu was soggy, and the flavor was weird. I don't know if I'll go back after that.

Usually, I just love this place but my last visit the fish from the fish and chips was all breading ... I barely could find the fish.  In fact it came out looking like a tennis ball.  As far as the Mozzerella Sticks ... now these were the bomb ... do not go there without trying an order.  Delish.  As far as all the new COVID regulations ... they were doing a very good job.

I popped into Pop, before meeting friends down the street. We were having dinner in the next block and I arrived early as usual and needed a drink and thought a nice bubbly would do. This was right before, we all were told to stay home and off the streets during this pandemic. Damn, it. I want this Covid-19 over, so I can return to Pop and experience more.

As a child, I thought Deviled Eggs were disgusting. I didn't even like the hard boiled eggs, the Easter Bunny brought. Now that I am an adult, I love'm. If I see them on a menu, I've got to have'm. So it was a no brainer to order them as an accompaniment to my Seelbach.  The spicy mustard, in these little devils, gave them a little extra twist and kick. 

The reason I enjoy a Seelbach, is that it is like a mash-up of a Manhattan (my favorite cocktail) and a Champagne cocktail. When you combine those two, it definitely is a winner. Pop uses, Old Forester 100, Cointreau, bitters and of course "bubbles" aka champagne, to make this a very refreshing cocktail. 

Being a single diner/drinker, I have a couple of "hot buttons" that I always look for and enjoy when seated at the bar. 1 - A simple hook under the bar. It's nice to have for hanging a light weight jacket or for the ladies to safely secure their purse. 2 - Linen Napkins. I just prefer them over paper. I hope this pandemic doesn't make us all switch over to paper napkins when dinning out. 

Pop, I'll be popping back in as soon as this Covid-19 has passed. I'm looking for
Dirty, nasty, and most of all RUDE.  It's a nasty place and the staff sucks.  Hoping to escape with only a mild case of food poisoning.  Pray for us.

I really love this place. Not only is the food ah-mazing, but Mouna and her family are so friendly and warm.  I can tell they put their heart and soul into The Mediterranean Chickpea.    I really love the falafel wrap.
My husband and I have visited several Perkins, but this is one of our favorites. Clean, good food, and all the staff very friendly. 100% good place

I ordered here from Grubhub and when the order was a half hour late, I called and asked for an update. They told me the driver was out with my order. Two hours after I placed the order I called to cancel it. They told me that "Tonya" delivered my order and that a "girl came out of the house to get it". Thing is, no one called me and I don't live in a house. After a back and forth for a bit, I told him that she obviously lied and he told me that "She's been with me a long time". I guess the customer isn't always right. Honestly, the fact that I was just lied to by a mediocre pizza place isn't really what I needed right now. 

I guess I learned my lesson though and should have listened to the other reviewer who said he was lied to too. 

Hard pass.
